read_files.observation: Describes paired RAW/RGB output,exposure-scaled packed LRD data and RAW/RGB/wavelet objective;not our physical-noise-conditioned camera-RGB interface.

Training combines0.7 RAW L1,0.2 RGB L1,0.1 wavelet. RGB prediction is clipped0..1 before loss. Validation scalar instead combines0.5 RAW,0.4 RGB,0.1 wavelet. These weights must not be treated as a single common train/validation objective.

One-level 2x2 Haar-style transform;sum of meanL1 differences over LL,LH,HL,HH. A helper named euclidean_distance uses L1,not Euclidean norm. Includes low-frequency error rather than exclusively high-frequency detail.
DWT low/high feature branches and RGB reconstruction;read for pipeline compatibility,not executed.

own_inference: A spatial/frequency loss proposal must specify actual transform,normalization,subband weighting and reduction;wavelet loss alone does not certify low-contrast detail or sky safety. Any later test needs our same native mesh/blank/quiet/flat controls. This reading does not change the fixed V166 trial.
